channel.title: The Valley Times-News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Valley Times-News (valleytimes-news.com)

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Dean Collins: Unplug to Listen
item.description: Dean Collins reflects on a tech-free phone, Amy Grant's lyrics, and a Lenten call to unplug from digital noise to better listen to God and be present with others.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - Loran Smith: Spring Training Ancillaries
item.description: Loran Smith recalls how spring training in Florida turns into more than baseball, from lucky snook catches and turkey hunts to museums and visits with football greats.

item.title: West Point celebrates Black History Month
item.description: West Point's 23rd Black History Program spotlights unity, youth achievement and community service, from student performances to $1 Thursday founder Anthony Talley and local scholarship honors.

item.title: Local chaplains attend Winter Olympics
item.description: The Chambers County-based International Sports Chaplains (ISC) again spread the gospel on the world stage, this time at the 2026 Winter Olympics held from Feb. 6 to Feb. 22 in Milan and Cortina, Italy.

item.title: First Rebel competition cheer team makes ‘herstory’
item.description: In its first year, Chambers Academy's new competition cheer squad earned a bid to Nationals in Orlando and finished in the Top 36.

item.title: Sheriff’s Office investigator leads Human Trafficking Awareness Seminar for healthcare workers
item.description: Wellstar West Georgia Medical Center staff trained by Troup County investigator to spot human trafficking victims and respond safely in care settings.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - John Tures: Don’t Expect Tariffs To Reduce The Trade Deficit, Or To Get A Tariff Rebate
item.description: After a Supreme Court defeat for Trump on tariffs, data show Americans paying higher trade taxes, record deficits persisting—and little chance of getting that money back.

item.title: Southern Union’s Therapeutic Massage Program prepares students for in-demand wellness careers
item.description: Southern Union is enrolling for its three-semester Therapeutic Massage Program, preparing students for licensure and in-demand careers in the growing health and wellness field.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - L. Michelle Moore: Behind the Meter Nuclear?
item.description: Behind-the-meter nuclear reactors are moving from military bases to tech giants like Microsoft, raising new questions about safety, oversight and community impacts.

item.title: Applications open for Coosa Valley RC&D scholarships
item.description: Coosa Valley RC&D is offering five $1,000 scholarships to high school seniors in its 10-county service area; apply by March 31 at coosavalley-rcd.org or by email or mail.
